message:
Plan A is feasible with capstone 90004, and I recommend keeping 90004. I drafted it only. Nothing is saved or registered.

Plan A (draft, v1): 90001, 90002, 90004 and 90010, for 13 credits.

Checks
- Required capstone and lab: 90004 is CAP4000, your required capstone. It requires lab 90010 (CAP4001L), which is in the plan.
- Protected courses: 90001 and 90002 are both kept.
- Prerequisites: The capstone needs CS3000 or CS3500 with at least a D-. You completed CS3000 with a B, so this is met.
- Credit limits: 13 credits is within your 12-16 range.
- Time conflicts: None. 90001 meets Mon 10:00-11:15. 90002 meets Wed 1:00-2:15 pm. 90004 meets Mon and Wed 8:00-9:15 am. 90010 meets Thu 5:30-5:50 pm.
- Work hours (Tue and Thu 12:00-5:00 pm): No overlap. The lab starts 30 minutes after your Thursday shift ends.
- Seats: 90004 has 1 seat left and 90010 has 2. 90001 and 90002 show 0 seats, but you're already enrolled in them. Seats can still be taken before you register, especially the last seat in 90004.

90004 vs. 90006
- Alternate capstone 90006 (Tue and Thu 10:00-11:40 am) would also work. It has no conflicts, ends 20 minutes before your shift, and also has 1 seat.
- I recommend 90004 because it leaves your Tuesday and Thursday work days clear, with a bigger buffer before work.
- Neither section meets in the afternoon, so your soft preference for afternoon classes doesn't separate them.
- If you'd rather have 90006, I can draft that version.

Enrollment: You're currently enrolled in 90001, 90002 and 90003. Plan A doesn't include 90003. If you register it later, 90003 would be dropped. I'd show you the exact add and drop first, and I'd need your approval before saving or registering.
